title.narrative: Investigative Journalism for a Transparent Belarus

description.narrative: Contract related to: Investigative Journalism for a Transparent Belarus - EU4People of Belarus: Sustain and Strengthen Resilience, Democratisation and Business Development¿ has the overall objective to sustain and strengthen the resilience of the Belarusian civil society, independent media, culture actors, and business.It will support the following three specific objectives:1.   Specific Objective 1 (Outcome 1): To ensure the continued existence of Belarusian civil society, which is able to promote democratic changes and human rights, including a strong, innovative and flexible independent Belarusian media sector, which circumvents state censorship and provides independent information to a growing audience of Belarusian citizens.2.    Specific Objective 2 (Outcome 2): To strengthen the Belarusian culture and art sector with a view to contribute to the preservation of the Belarusian cultural space and national identity.Specific Objective 3 (Outcome 3): To continue strengthening the Belarusian business sector not linked with the Belarusian authorities, including female entrepreneurs, which will form the basis of a new and sound business environment once a democratic transition takes place
